flags.description: Chef mode: the Settings switch (Steps section) for short steps written on the device, shown in the reading view and cook mode.
The free tier: 20 recipes, a one-time unlock for unlimited, the Settings row to buy or restore it and the Recipes count. Off until the store products exist.

A recipe picked from the page's text by the on-device model when the page has no JSON-LD or microdata recipe: every line kept is checked to be on the page, and the reading view says so. Needs ML Kit's Prompt API on Android (fewer phones than Chef mode: on Samsung only the S26, Z Fold7/8, Z Flip8 and TriFold) or Apple Intelligence on iOS; other phones and unsupported languages behave as before.

Typed decisions by the on-device model where the rules give up: whether a close pantry name is the same ingredient (Have/Buy), and the aisle of an item the keyword table puts in Other. Only a definite answer given twice with high confidence acts. Needs the same model as llmExtraction (Prompt API or Apple Intelligence); other phones and unsupported languages behave as before. Count brackets stay as written unless aiCountBrackets is on too.

With aiDecisions on, also asks the model whether a count's bracket is the total or each item's, and scales the line by its answer. Off, those lines scale as without the model. Kept to re-measure: the #105 evaluation found it confidently wrong on 4 of 22.

Reddit posts: a reddit.com or redd.it link (a /s/ share link is followed first) is read from the post's .json listing: the post body, else a transcription in the comments, else the post's photo and title with a note that no recipe text was found. Off, Reddit links go through the blog parsers like any page.

Read the photo: on a Reddit post with no recipe text, a button reads the post's photo (each picture of a gallery, in order) with on-device text recognition (ML Kit's bundled Latin model on Android, Vision on iOS). The lines are sorted by the Reddit splitter into the recipe editor for the cook to check (unsure lines are marked); nothing is saved without that. When nothing sorts, the editor opens with the title, photo and any lines read. Also Scan a recipe (#226): the cook's own photos, taken, picked or shared in, read the same way and saved as a typed-in recipe.
